provenance.baseline_catalog: Seven predefined Earth windows remain a separate production analysis.

earth_source.title: NOAA ETOPO1 Ice Surface via NOAA/AOML ERDDAP

model.distance: sqrt(mean(((Earth feature - planetary feature) / Earth feature IQR)^2))
model.normalization: Earth training-set median and interquartile range (IQR); query uses fitted Earth scale

scope_limitations: Bounded regional search, not global or representative of all terrestrial terrain.
Natural Earth 1:50m mask omits small water features and has generalized shorelines.
The glaciated-area screen is historical and cannot establish absence of seasonal snow or current ice.
ETOPO1 grid spacing and interpolation do not establish effective terrain resolution.
Nearest within generated windows is not a validated planetary analog.

range_diagnostics.interpretation: The reference is outside the observed Earth range for at least one descriptor. The nearest available candidate is only a relative result; this catalog does not support a confident comparison.
